hypotheses.evidence: The profile prompt raised mean B1 score from 67.5522 to 84.2839 versus the minimal prompt, but passed only 20.83% of hard gates.
hypotheses.major_factor: Replace minimal prompting with the frozen house profile card.
hypotheses.next_action: Retain as a baseline component; do not promote alone.

hypotheses.evidence: Approved-example retrieval reached 84.8283 mean and 37.50% hard gates, improving hard-gate coverage over the profile-only baseline.
hypotheses.major_factor: Add frozen retrieval of approved examples to the same small local model.
hypotheses.next_action: Retain retrieval in the strongest local branch.

hypotheses.evidence: The full ledger/draft/verify/revise path scored 81.3694 with 33.33% hard gates and 7.240-second mean latency, below retrieval and compact-ledger alternatives.
hypotheses.major_factor: Add a local verification and revision pass after ledger-guided drafting.
hypotheses.next_action: Do not repeat on the 0.5B base without a materially different verifier or model.

hypotheses.evidence: Compact ledger/draft reached 87.1981 mean and 50% hard gates and remains the local directional quality/fidelity leader.
hypotheses.major_factor: Use a compact claims/decision ledger followed by one bounded draft pass.
hypotheses.next_action: Retain as the mandatory non-training/local comparison baseline.

hypotheses.evidence: The templated smoke LoRA regressed both matched strategies, reaching 0% and 4.17% hard gates with repetition, omissions, and retrieval-example leakage.
hypotheses.major_factor: Apply a small profile-conditioned LoRA update using the initial synthetic smoke corpus.
hypotheses.next_action: Retain only as pipeline proof; never repeat the templated data recipe.

hypotheses.evidence: All eleven source-text-free profile cards executed on six shared cases; several were directionally positive, but the slice was coverage-only and cannot select a winner.
hypotheses.major_factor: Render all eleven descriptive profiles on neutral shared content without source text.
hypotheses.next_action: Retain all profile configurations and defer selection to full task evidence.

hypotheses.evidence: The genuine unified LoRA changed profile by -0.6715 and ledger by +0.6820 points; it leaked training scenario labels in 20 and 15 cases and retained severe repetition.
hypotheses.major_factor: Train one unified three-profile LoRA on 90 project-owned task/style/preference records.
hypotheses.next_action: Reject the adapter; require authentic diverse approved task pairs before another unified update.

hypotheses.evidence: Ox v1 scored 91.0738 but 8 of 24 outputs contained step/tool preambles and six had material source-expansion risk.
hypotheses.major_factor: Use Ox Alpha as a one-step source-only candidate generator with tools denied.
hypotheses.next_action: Reject the raw candidate; preserve only ceiling diagnostics.

hypotheses.evidence: Ox v2 raised mean to 93.5438 and eliminated all eight meta preambles, but passed only 13 of 24 hard gates and retained six material source-expansion risks.
hypotheses.major_factor: Increase the no-tools OpenCode agent from one to two steps and strengthen generic artifact-only instructions.
hypotheses.next_action: Accept the harness repair but reject the writing candidate.

hypotheses.evidence: V2's dominant remaining failures are unsupported inferred commitments and paraphrased operative facts; a source-only second pass directly targets both without evaluator access.
hypotheses.major_factor: Generate a fresh draft, then use a separate no-tools Ox session to revise it against the same source and task fields with exact operative-phrase preservation.
hypotheses.next_action: Preregister and run once; require all 24 hard gates and a clean output audit.

hypotheses.evidence: The 0.5B local family appears capacity-limited while external Ox demonstrates a large quality gap; 18 GiB unified memory may support one bounded larger local inference probe.
hypotheses.major_factor: Hold compact-ledger architecture fixed and replace the 0.5B base with one resource-feasible larger local instruct model.
hypotheses.next_action: Probe inventory, disk, and memory after h10; freeze one candidate only if the download and runtime remain zero-cost and bounded.

hypotheses.evidence: Project-owned synthetic data was insufficient and named-source material has no training-approved rows; neither Codex nor Ox may promote rights status.
hypotheses.major_factor: Train on diverse authentic rough-material-to-final task pairs with explicit negative fidelity controls.
hypotheses.next_action: Remain blocked until qualified rights approval and authentic pairs exist; continue non-training work.

hypotheses.evidence: Seven pinned adapters and real-source schemas validate, but benchmark source artifacts have not been acquired or executed.
hypotheses.major_factor: Run the pinned WritingBench, IteraTeR, EditEval, Revision for Concision, and YapBench adapters on acquired source files.
hypotheses.next_action: Acquire only from documented canonical sources under the frozen rights and hash workflow.

hypotheses.evidence: No named source satisfies both the minimum training-data sufficiency threshold and training-approved rights status.
hypotheses.major_factor: Train separate LoRA adapters for individual named profiles.
hypotheses.next_action: Do not execute weak or unapproved adapters; retain conditioned coverage instead.
